newsitem.title: UK: European precious metals close firmer.
newsitem.headline: European precious metals close firmer.

text.p: GOLD - Closed at $319.80/$320.30 up just 40 cents from Thursday. Prices came off intraday high on inflation friendly U.S. economic data. Bear trend intact.
SILVER - Ended five cents firmer at $4.38/$4.40.
PLATINUM - Bounced with gold/palladium to $405.50/$409.50 from $396.00/$400.00.
PALLADIUM - Oversold, off floor at $166.50/$170.50 up $4.50.
